fullQ7Coverage.argument: Ear triangles partition the original polygon area exactly. Every split replaces one triangle by two exact midpoint triangles. Each leaf triangle lies strictly in a radius7 disk centred at an exact original Q(t), because all three vertices have positive radius-squared margin. Convex disks contain each leaf interior.
